decision: Held decision: nodal intermediate lift gas fields had no route (W2 left them for a W4 panel mode that no wave built). Owner approved the lead recommendation 2026-09-22: add a typed-case panel mode (audit recommendation: editable column inputs, six-decimal print clears the 7.6e-4 tol).

intermediate.pointer: On the course panel, the Outflow explorer's "Your gas column, typed" view takes this injection column as typed (gravity, tubing head pressure, both depths, both temperatures and the step count) and prints the pressures at the bottom of the column (the valve depth) and at its midpoint station to six decimals.

liftgas_valve_pwf_psia.evidence: HD (held decision, owner approved the lead recommendation 2026-09-22): a typed mode on VlpExplorer.jsx ("Your gas column, typed", typedGasColumn in nodalLab.js: one call to the vendored engine's cullenderSmithBhp on the typed tubing head pressure, gravity, measured and vertical depth, both temperatures and step count) takes the column the learner types. Typing the brief's column (0.72, 1225 psia, 8900 ft MD, 8300 ft TVD, 96 to 214 degF, 20 steps) prints the value at 6 dp within tol; yourCase.test.js proves it, that the BONNY-7 default and the panel's opening view land on no graded answer (D2 rules 1 to 3), and that the two station default or a vertical depth typed as the measured one misses.
